select taskcomment, str.storeroomno, str.storeroomname, i.checktaskno, i.checkdesc, i.checktaskid from checktask i join CHECKBILL bill on i.TASKSOURCE = bill.CHECKBILLID left join storeroom str on i.storeroomid = str.storeroomid and str.roomtag = #{roomTag} join ( select distinct r.USER_ID as userid, m.STOREROOMID as operation from sys_user_role r,sys_role_room m where r.ROLE_ID=m.ROLE_ID and r.USER_ID=#{roleoRuserId} ) u on u.operation = str.storeroomid where (bill.BILLSTATE = 1 or bill.BILLSTATE = 3) and ( (i.collecter = #{iUserId} and
i.checkmethod <> 4) or i.checkmethod = 4) order by i.checkdate desc
select d.* from CHECKTASK d, CO_CHECKITEM i, CHECKCOLLECTDATA c where d.CHECKTASKID = i.CHECKTASKID and i.CO_CHECKITEMID = c.CHCEKTASKITEMID and d.CHECKTASKNO = #{taskcomment}

select aa.* from( SELECT stroom.storeroomno AS storeroomno, stroom.storeroomno AS storesite, stroom.storeroomno AS matcode2, NULL AS palletno, DECODE(o.checkmethod,0,'库位',4,'全盘盘点','物料') AS checkmethod_nm, 0 AS collectdataqty, o.checktaskno checktaskno, cc.subinventory_code AS subinventory_code, '' AS status, oi.co_checkitemid, o.taskcomment, o.tasksource, stroom.storeroomno storesiteno, stroom.storeroomno matcode, bill.billstate, o.checkmethod, stroom.roomtag FROM checktask o JOIN co_checkitem oi ON o.checktaskid = oi.checktaskid JOIN checkcontent cc ON oi.checkcontentid = cc.checkcontentid AND o.tasksource = cc.checkbillid JOIN checkbill bill ON o.tasksource = bill.checkbillid LEFT JOIN storeroom stroom ON oi.checksite = stroom.storeroomid WHERE (bill.billstate = 1 OR bill.billstate = 3) AND o.checkmethod = 4
and o.taskcomment= #{taskcomment} and o.checktaskno= #{checktaskno} and stroom.roomtag= #{roomTag}
UNION ALL SELECT str.storeroomno AS storeroomno, GetStoreSiteNoByCheckSite(bill.checkbillid,oi.checksite) storesite, NVL(sts.storesiteno, pm.matcode) matcode2, GetPalletNoByCheckSite(bill.checkbillid,oi.checksite) AS palletno, DECODE(o.checkmethod,0,'库位',4,'全盘盘点','物料') AS checkmethod_nm, nvl(GetCheckCollectDataByCheckSite(oi.co_checkitemid),0) AS collectdataqty, o.checktaskno, cc.subinventory_code AS subinventory_code, '' AS status, oi.co_checkitemid, o.taskcomment, o.tasksource, sts.storesiteno, pm.matcode, bill.billstate, o.checkmethod, str.roomtag FROM checktask o JOIN co_checkitem oi ON o.checktaskid = oi.checktaskid JOIN checkcontent cc ON oi.checkcontentid = cc.checkcontentid AND o.tasksource = cc.checkbillid JOIN checkbill bill ON o.tasksource = bill.checkbillid JOIN storeroom str ON str.storeroomid = o.storeroomid LEFT JOIN pm_material pm ON oi.checksite = pm.pm_materialid LEFT JOIN storesite sts ON oi.checksite = sts.storesiteid WHERE (bill.billstate = 1 OR bill.billstate = 3) AND o.checkmethod <> 4
and o.taskcomment= #{taskcomment} and o.checktaskno= #{checktaskno} and str.roomtag= #{roomTag} )aa where aa.billstate = 1 or aa.billstate = 3 order by aa.storesiteno, aa.matcode

select distinct a.palletno, e.storesiteno, c.checktaskno, d.storeroomno, c.checktaskid from checkorder a, checkbill b, checktask c, storeroom d, storesite e where a.checkbillid = b.checkbillid and a.checkbillid = c.tasksource and c.storeroomid = d.storeroomid and d.storeroomid = e.storeroomid and a.checksite = e.storesiteid and (b.billstate = 1 or b.billstate = 3) and (a.checkstate = 1 or a.checkstate = 2) and a.palletno is not null and c.taskcomment = #{taskcomment} and c.checktaskid = #{checktaskid} and c.checkmethod = #{checkmethod} order by a.palletno ) order by a.interface_wms_to_wcs_id desc
